payload.message: add a /healthz endpoint to the server that returns 200 OK

content.text: I'll register a healthz handler on the mux that writes 200 OK.

payload.name: apply_patch
payload.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: server/server.go
@@
-	mux.HandleFunc("/v1/items", items)
+	mux.HandleFunc("/v1/items", items)
+	mux.HandleFunc("/healthz", healthz)
@@
-	w.Write([]byte("[]"))
-}
+	w.Write([]byte("[]"))
+}
+
+// healthz reports that the server is up with 200 OK.
+func healthz(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	w.Write([]byte("ok"))
+}
*** End Patch
